create.title: Exact reduced-Farey form of the W=Y^(7/16) actual M1/M2 cluster
create.statement_tex: Fix W=Y^(7/16), one literal M1 or M2 dyadic block d asymp D, |h| asymp L, and one fixed moving-symbol stratum. Write h/d=a/b in lowest terms and aggregate every lift (h,d)=(ga,gb) before taking absolute values. With kappa_1=1 and kappa_2=4, the reduced coefficients A_i(a,b) retain the literal Vaaler taper, profiles, floors, hard top, stars, both signs, and character placement; bounded sampled variation and the common lift character chi_4(g) give |A_i(a,b)|<<_epsilon Y^epsilon/L and sum_(a,b)=1 |A_i(a,b)|^2<<_epsilon Y^epsilon D/L. The complete triangular energy splits into this equal-frequency diagonal and a signed off-diagonal with determinant n=ab'-a'b, phase e(cn/(kappa_i bb')), and weight (1-W|n|/(kappa_i bb'))_+. Farey spacing gives the coefficient-blind bound Y^epsilon(D/L)(1+min(DL,D^2/W)), which is target-safe outside 3delta-ell>15/16. At (delta,ell)=(1/2,1/6) its capacity is Y^(43/48+epsilon), missing the Y^(1/2+epsilon) target by Y^(19/48); a phase-conjugating bounded-coefficient model attains this false-shadow capacity. Polylogarithmically many fixed strata assemble without deleting bottom, R5, endpoint, or cross-sign owners. This is a reduction and no-go, not a signed determinant estimate, canonical-core estimate, M9 theorem, or quarter theorem.
create.next_action: Use the exact determinant form as the only Round-95 internal survivor. Any improvement must exploit its literal phase and M1/M2 character placements, not coefficient-blind Farey degree.

create.title: Actual signed reduced-determinant correlation at W=Y^(7/16)
create.statement_tex: For W=Y^(7/16), every hard literal M1/M2 block and every fixed moving-symbol stratum, prove that the one-sided sum over n=ab'-a'b>0 of A_i(a,b) conjugate(A_i(a',b')) e(cn/(kappa_i bb'))(1-Wn/(kappa_i bb')) is O_epsilon(Y^(1/2+epsilon)), uniformly for kappa_1=1 and kappa_2=4. The coefficients must retain the actual Vaaler taper, chi_4 on the literal M1 or M2 coordinate, common lift character, both signs, profiles, floors, hard top, stars, and exact reduced supports. The equal-frequency diagonal is already O_epsilon(D/L); the open issue is signed cancellation in the nonzero determinant. With logarithmic all-block assembly, bottom, and R5 ownership, this lemma would imply P(X)<<_epsilon X^(5/16+epsilon), but it would not prove either canonical M9 core or the quarter target.
create.next_action: Seek a phase-sensitive determinant or additive-divisor estimate with the literal character placements, or prove a fixed power saving in Popov's additive local-discrepancy term.

create.title: Repaired Li--Yang real-X Gauss-circle exponent
create.statement_tex: For every epsilon>0 and every real X>=2, the inclusive Gauss-circle discrepancy P(X)=N(sqrt(X))-pi X satisfies P(X)<<_epsilon X^(theta_LY+epsilon), where theta_LY=(3292+25sqrt(1717))/13762=0.3144831759740614.... This accepts only the final application after four unique literal repairs: M<T^(7/16), H=MT^x, sqrt(-1-8x) in Li--Yang (5.27), and the exact two-sign circle identity from Bourgain--Watt v1 (7.2). The missing Guth--Maldague beta_2>=0 condition is proved on the final x-range by -(8x+3)(3908x+753)>=0, and the missing Case-B logarithm is absorbed by fixed power slack on the final Case-II range. The printed general Proposition 3.1 and general Case-B theorem are not accepted. This direct external theorem does not prove the project's internal cluster theorem, M9-M1, M9-M2, M9, or exponent one quarter.
create.next_action: Use this as the strongest certified global pointwise theorem and a benchmark only. Keep the repaired range and nonimplication scope explicit.
